_format.ruby: Write readings inline as 漢字{かんじ}. The renderer turns them into <ruby>.
_format.slots: {name} {food} {hobby} {job} {place} are filled from memory. A line is skipped if a slot is unknown.

fields.b: bubbles — she sends several in a row, like a real chat
fields.q: sets pendingSlot: the user's next message is stored in this slot
fields.cond: { minAff, maxAff, stage, needSlot, lacksSlot, minTurns, flag, notFlag, dayType: 'weekday'|'weekend', dayOfWeek: 'sunday'…'saturday' }; nextTopic keeps a conversation thread alive for another reply

photos.kind: 'scene' (her surroundings — frequent, 5-turn cooldown) or 'selfie' (rarer, 12-turn cooldown, what 「写真見せて」 reaches for first)
photos.when: { intent: [...], topic: [...], band: [...] } — when she'd naturally send it. A photo with no `when` only ever appears on the random path.
photos.minAffection: how close she has to feel before this one is on the table
